independentLayers.description: Reference numbers for the trigger, popup, items, group labels and separators.
Roles, data-* and navigation shared by both renderers.

intent: Offer a list of actions or options from a trigger, shown on demand

properties.description: Whether the popup is open (reflected). Setting it opens or closes without an openchange event; a submenu closes with its menu.
Open at connect; focus stays where it is (an interaction moves it into the popup).
Preset: the generated trigger's text (with a trailing caret) when no trigger part is authored.
The trigger ignores presses, keys and hover (aria-disabled, data-disabled); a disabled submenu's trigger is a disabled item.
Preferred side of the trigger: bottom (default) or top; the popup flips when that side has no room. Submenus always open at the inline end.
Alignment along the side: start (default), center or end.
Open when the pointer rests on the trigger for `delay` ms (reason trigger-hover). Submenus always do.
The rest before a hover opens the popup, in ms.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

events.name: openchange
events.trigger: a trigger press, key or hover opens the popup, or an item press, outside press, Escape, ArrowLeft (submenu) or focus leaving closes it; preventDefault keeps it as it is

events.name: change
events.detail: checkbox item: { checked: boolean, reason: 'item-press', event }; radio group: { value: string, reason: 'item-press', event }
events.trigger: a press (or Enter / Space) on a checkbox item toggles its checked attribute (dispatched on the item), or on a radio item sets its radio group's value (dispatched on the group); preventDefault keeps the state

semantics.role: none (the trigger is role=button with aria-haspopup=menu, the popup role=menu, items menuitem / menuitemcheckbox / menuitemradio)

keyboard.keys: Enter, Space, ArrowDown on the trigger
keyboard.action: open the popup on the first item (ArrowUp: the last)
move focus to the next / previous enabled item, wrapping
move focus to the first / last enabled item
move focus to the next item whose label starts with the typed text
activate it (click); checkbox and radio items toggle

keyboard.keys: ArrowRight (ArrowLeft in RTL), Enter, Space on a submenu trigger
keyboard.action: open the submenu on its first item

keyboard.keys: ArrowLeft (ArrowRight in RTL) in a submenu
keyboard.action: close it, focus back on its trigger
close the topmost open menu, focus back on its trigger
close the menu (focus-out) and move on

sources: the trigger's text (the popup is aria-labelledby the trigger)

content.children: A [data-part=trigger] and a [data-part=popup] holding item, checkbox-item, radio-item, separator, group (with a group-label) and radio-group parts and nested ui-menu submenus (a [data-part=submenu-trigger] and a popup). Preset: the items alone, with label; the trigger and popup are generated.

constraints: The popup stays in the DOM, hidden (popover=manual); it is shown in the top layer while open.
Item activation is the item's click event; the application listens to it on the item or the host.
A checkbox item's state is its checked attribute and a radio group's its value attribute; the menu toggles them on a press (cancelable change).
Setting open from script opens or closes without an openchange event and leaves focus where it is.

avoidWhen.when: Choosing a value for a form field.
avoidWhen.reason: A menu runs actions and submits nothing; a select is a form-associated choice.
A menu hides its actions behind a trigger; buttons keep them one press away.

avoidWhen.when: Site or app navigation between pages.
avoidWhen.reason: Menu items are actions, not links; navigation needs a navigation menu (not in the kit yet).

nodes.summary: The trigger (role=button, aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded, aria-controls; data-popup-open, data-pressed, data-disabled), the construction pattern inside. Base UI Menu.Trigger.
The popup (role=menu, popover=manual, tabindex -1; data-open / data-closed, data-side, data-align): a floating composite placed by the trigger. Base UI Menu.Positioner and Menu.Popup in one element.
An action (role=menuitem, tabindex -1; data-highlighted, data-disabled) in the construction pattern; a press fires its click and closes the menu. Base UI Menu.Item.

A toggle (role=menuitemcheckbox, aria-checked from its checked attribute; data-checked / data-unchecked, data-highlighted, data-disabled) with an indicator in its leading slot. Base UI Menu.CheckboxItem.
One choice of a radio group (role=menuitemradio, checked when its value is the group's; data-checked / data-unchecked, data-highlighted, data-disabled) with a dot indicator. Base UI Menu.RadioItem.

A checkbox or radio item's indicator in its leading slot (aria-hidden; data-checked / data-unchecked): the check icon or the dot, its space kept while unchecked. Base UI CheckboxItemIndicator, RadioItemIndicator.

A nested ui-menu's trigger, an item of this popup (role=menuitem, aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded; data-popup-open, data-highlighted, data-disabled) with a trailing caret. Base UI Menu.SubmenuTrigger.
A set of items (role=group, aria-labelledby its group label). Base UI Menu.Group.
A group's visible name, muted, on the item inset. Base UI Menu.GroupLabel.
Radio items sharing one value (role=group; the value attribute). Base UI Menu.RadioGroup.
A horizontal rule between items (role=separator; data-orientation). Base UI Menu.Separator.
